transcript: Hello, everyone. Welcome to Pine Pool. We open at eight on weekdays. On Sunday we open at ten. The small pool is for children, and the large pool is for adults. You need a yellow ticket for today's swimming lesson. Please give it to your teacher, Rosa. The lesson starts at eleven and lasts thirty minutes. You can leave your shoes in the box under the bench. Please bring your own towel. We sell water at the front desk, but we do not sell towels. Today the shower in room two is broken. Please use the shower in room three. Thank you, and enjoy your swim.
